intro: Panama is an S-shaped country between the Caribbean and the Pacific.

chapters.title: Land
text: Volcán Barú is the highest point, from which on clear days you can see both oceans. The Darién Gap in the east is a roadless jungle on the Colombian border. The San Blas islands lie in the Caribbean.

chapters.title: Water for the canal
text: Gatún Lake, made by damming a river, supplies the water that lifts ships; droughts in 2023 limited traffic.

keyTerms.meaning: A wild jungle with no road between Panama and Colombia.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Panama's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
